name: google-play-store
description: Inspect Play tracks, staged rollouts, uploaded artifacts, and recent reviews, and drive a staged rollout safely.

service_account_path.title: Google Play service account key
service_account_path.description: Select a service account JSON key with access to your app in Play Console. The local server reads this file to authenticate with Google.

package_name.title: Default Android package
package_name.description: Optional app package, such as com.example.app. Tool calls can override it.

enable_writes.title: Enable release writes
enable_writes.description: Allow tools that publish releases, change or halt rollouts, and upload Data safety declarations. These actions change real Play Store state.
